scenes.headline: How SWE-1.7 is trained by an asynchronous RL loop
scenes.sub: Cognition's coding model: async actors, top-p replay, weight deltas.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dazzle! SWE-1.7 is Cognition's coding model for Devin. Here's how it was trained.

scenes.text: SWE-1.7 is pure RL on Kimi K2.7, a base already RL-trained, run as an asynchronous loop so the trainer never waits.
scenes.say: SWE-1.7 is pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K2.7, a base that was already RL-trained. The loop is asynchronous, so the trainer never waits for the slowest rollout.

steps.say: Inference engines generate long coding rollouts nonstop, and push each finished trajectory into a buffer.
The trainer learns from whatever is ready. Those rollouts came from a slightly stale policy, so importance sampling keeps the gradients honest.
After each step, the trainer ships a compressed weight delta, not the weights, through cloud object storage.

steps.note: a delta is over 99% smaller than a full broadcast
steps.say: Engines prefetch it while serving, then pause three to four seconds to apply it. A cross-continental update lands in one to two minutes.

scenes.title: Top-p sampling distribution replay
scenes.say: Long RL runs die of entropy collapse: punishing a junk token feeds the token that already leads.

items.say: So first, sample only from the top-p set. Junk tokens never become targets.
The trainer sees the full vocabulary, so record which tokens were kept at rollout time.
The trainer renormalizes over that same mask. Now they agree, and entropy holds roughly constant.
A bonus: a token already above the threshold keeps only itself. Its probability is one, so its gradient is zero.

scenes.title: FrontierCode 1.1 Main, pass rate
scenes.say: As Cognition reports it: twelve point two points over its own base. Roughly GPT-5.5's level, with Opus 4.8 still ahead.

scenes.text: Keep the trainer fed, and keep sampler and trainer on the same distribution. That recipe is the real payload.

recap: A replayed top-p mask stops entropy collapse
Weight deltas, not weights, cross continents
scenes.say: To recap: an asynchronous loop, a replayed top-p mask, and weight deltas instead of weights.
